description: Human policy for klin; repository facts and semantic validation remain native to klin. klin reads the klin.json at the worktree root, or in the starting directory outside a worktree, and never one below the root; `--config PATH` names another file. Without a file, `klin check`, `klin status` and `klin policy` run under `{}`, and the hooks stay silent.

accepted.description: the debt a person accepted, each entry a site and a reason. Only a person writes it. Source: pinned only. Default: nothing is accepted.

build.description: a build command a person chose over the derived one: a command, a list of entries of a `run` and an optional `root`, or `false` to build nothing. Source: derived when absent. Derivation rule: one command per standard manifest, from the fixed table of ADR 0012.

cc.description: the cyclomatic complexity a function may not pass. Source: derived when absent. Derivation rule: the 95th percentile of `cc` over every supported function selected by the compact scope recorded at the derivation commit, rounded up to the next whole number, with a floor of 10, and the floor itself below 50 functions.

in.description: a repository-relative path, or a list of them, the section applies to, with everything below each. Source: pinned only. Default: the whole repository.

lines.description: the body length a function outside test code may not pass. Source: derived when absent. Derivation rule: the 95th percentile of `lines`, by the same rule as `cc`, test code included, with a floor of 25.

test_lines.description: the body length a function in test code may not pass: in a test file of spec 5.4, or in a Rust item marked `#[cfg(test)]`, such as an inline test module. Source: pinned only. Default: test code is not judged on length.
